The PR changes only the model identifier and SDK-level thinking parameters in examples. It adds no Go-only public feature, default, or behavior, and the scenarios keep matching upstream sample coverage. I did not review the .NET samples, and I did not compare model names against upstream, because a model-name refresh is not a parity concern. No parity issues found.
